acceptance: When premortem --prompt-only --record-verdict runs without a signing key, it warns on stderr that the recorded entry is unsigned.
When recordVerdict throws (e.g. broken or signed-then-unsigned manifest chain), premortem exits 1 via opError with a clean error message rather than an unhandled exception stack trace.
description: In packages/premortem/lib/run.mjs, warn on stderr when --record-verdict runs without ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY and route recordVerdict/readVerdictSource errors through opError with repair-chain guidance instead of throwing a raw stack trace.
title: premortem: wrap recordVerdict in opError and warn on unsigned record (#723)
